title: Sales Receipt Hold on Pocketwire Personal Account Balance Transfers
content:
Goods-and-services payments received into a Pocketwire Personal Account are held back from a transfer of the whole available balance according to the account's selling history.

**Rule.** The sales receipt hold on the available transfer amount reads the goods-and-services payments received into the account:

- when every such payment the account ever received is dated in the last three months (a new seller), the goods-and-services payments dated in the last two months are held in full;
- when the account received such a payment before the last three months (an established seller), only the single most recent goods-and-services payment it received is held;
- when the account never received one, nothing is held.

A payment counts inside a window of N months when it is dated later than the same calendar day N months before the handling date. The most recent payment is the one with the latest transaction date. Personal payments received are not goods-and-services payments and play no part in the hold.

| Goods-and-services payments received | Seller | Held |
|---|---|---|
| All of them dated in the last three months | New seller | The total of those dated in the last two months |
| At least one dated before the last three months | Established seller | The most recent one only |
| None ever | — | Nothing |

**Cases (hypothetical, handling date 20 August)**

The last three months are the dates after 20 May; the last two months are the dates after 20 June.

- Received 300.00 on 1 July and 200.00 on 10 August, nothing earlier: new seller, 500.00 held.
- Received only 400.00 on 1 June: new seller; no payment dated in the last two months, so 0.00 held.
- Received one payment in January and 90.00 on 12 August as the latest: established seller, 90.00 held.
